body:
Two additional source-partonomy findings are confirmed within this preparation-family issue: `W05-FINAL-CHEM-NEW-02` and `W05-FINAL-CHEM-NEW-03`. Their original before-fix reports and all four published payload hashes are preserved; this is a proposed correction, not acceptance of the full successor.

| Existing proposal | Primary evidence and supported whole-stock description |
|---|---|
| CHEM-C1193-HEPES-1221 and CHEM-C1193-HEPES-1474 | [NBRC1221](https://www.nite.go.jp/nbrc/catalogue/NBRCMediumDetailServlet?NO=1221) and [NBRC1474](https://www.nite.go.jp/nbrc/catalogue/NBRCMediumDetailServlet?NO=1474) specify a 1 M HEPES-KOH additive. The separately stated receiving-medium pH values do not specify stock pH. |
| CHEM-C1193-DSMZ_394_1137-Tris | [DSMZ394](https://www.dsmz.de/microorganisms/medium/pdf/DSMZ_Medium394.pdf) and [DSMZ1137](https://www.dsmz.de/microorganisms/medium/pdf/DSMZ_Medium1137.pdf) specify a 1 M Tris-HCl stock at pH7.5, with different receiving doses. |
| CHEM-C1193-JCM_1061-Tris | [JCM1061](https://www.jcm.riken.jp/cgi-bin/jcm/jcm_grmd?GRMD=1061) specifies a 0.5 M Tris-HCl stock at pH8.0. |

All five primary documents were fetched successfully for this check. None enumerates the proposed stock's preparation inputs. The candidates nevertheless use `RECIPE_TRANSCRIPTION` to assert total buffer moieties and potassium-containing or chloride species as material components. Those descriptions are inferred chemical/speciation categories. Under MAPPING_SEMANTICS section6, an ion or speciation bridge cannot stand in for a material has-part assertion. Nominal stock strength does not establish free-base/salt fractions, potassium stoichiometry or separately supplied free KOH/HCl. Merely changing the assertion method would not make these material inputs supported.

The bounded correction is to omit the unsupported `components` and their paired `component_assertion`, while retaining the useful whole-stock names, source-stated strengths/pH, exact occurrence routing, evidence, original history and explicit unknown composition. Do not substitute dry Tris hydrochloride, infer solvent or titration inputs, borrow receiving-medium water/pH, or treat unknown stock details as proof that the two HEPES preparations differ. This does not change the separate solid Tris-HCl parent-grade finding in #1238. Full successor review and native validation remain required; no owner, role or export approval follows.

Reproduction is saved at `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/buffer-source-parts-triage-v1/`. Original finding SHA256s: `ef1bc8a7f7ea8ff459305fb71b1864baec2d3c8fff72df3855d79b428aea0f49` and `99be33af59ae5ea2abad4f7df98b414b528147047076357bc5b21b48043412f9`. Payload hashes are `05cf4a1b09aff0fd1954ef0ac1aa563844414f4896261eaca48271323d9f8a46`, `6ba28f7de8b9b6387fb38f44ec01ce9b9626a84bea256ea63b7d0df07b109fad`, `0f8cf263079c547959a4b82831900988b2e07df24eb59c51e62e97fb675733ac`, and `9009b7dc6651004a025591c4e9376e117d4978bc7049b91e2001352bcf83561b`.

Reviewed W02 head `0597d00417be4d7cdfb5a31970043eec9bbc88fe`, frozen campaign base `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`. Authoritative peer review is `assembly-v2/review.yaml` (SHA256 `31cac38cae0cfb3dcfae4453a01402dc98d249f70ad9a7698a89b25eed5eae11`) in the sealed W04 independent W02 packet, whose 2,399-member SHA256SUMS is `99306617655b1e3df84368079e49f4341a0fd05667bdf9fedf18dda24f4f7ca7`. The coordinator verified all manifest members, rebound all188 case decisions and106 selected payloads, and independently repeated all106 native guarded writes and baseline/overlay partonomy. Structural validation passes; the scientific verdict remains needs_curation. These are unapplied proposal corrections, not changes already made to main or whole-owner/export approval.

Add the exact W02 preparation-family extension `W02-F-IRON-STOCK-DUPLICATE` (`w02-external-b-004`), cases53/176. The [DSMZ718 recipe](https://www.dsmz.de/microorganisms/medium/pdf/DSMZ_Medium718.pdf) (SHA256 `09faeca86ec0358bcdc3b5674e2323ac61c3ca554a9323bb09eb6f06fa6feb1c`) and [DSMZ399 recipe](https://www.dsmz.de/microorganisms/medium/pdf/DSMZ_Medium399.pdf) (`29f9f4df24231ba04f8113f3f7b6d8fd82b186c000608627ad02905808ae7ed0`) both state the literal seven-water ferrous ammonium sulfate stock at0.1%w/v,2mL receiving dose. One candidate expresses1g/L, which is the same stated strength.

| Proposal | Owner | Exact selected SHA256 |
|---|---|---|
| `a2-proposal-dsmz718-ferrous-ammonium-sulfate-stock` | `data/ingredients/mapped/dsmz718_ferrous_ammonium_sulfate_stock.yaml` | `4c8c6b0ee75793b83bddc54f795c249084429aa86e306abd44212c3316d9f818` |
| `c2-proposal-ferrous-ammonium-heptahydrate-stock` | `data/ingredients/mapped/dsmz399_ferrous_ammonium_sulfate_heptahydrate_0_1pct_wv_stock.yaml` | `afcdaa60b415472c2a2663da9f52475149aeb080248cce0598f606d86c837f2b` |

Reconcile the overlapping supported partial-preparation scope into one justified nominal candidate or establish a positive material distinction before co-installation. Do not infer complete formulation equivalence from the same listed solute/strength; unknown solvent/batch details are neither proof of equality nor disjointness. Preserve both exact source/case lineages and the literal seven waters without silently converting to conventional Mohr hexahydrate. The sealed review's stronger early phrase "same stock" is qualified by its final root adjudication, which does not assert full composition equivalence.

The separate W02-F-PREPARATIONS DSMZ375/1107 cysteine overlap is a second family dependency under1201. Keep375's unknown strength/solvent/filtration distinct from1107's explicit5%w/v scope; do not create a chemically disjoint owner solely because source numbers differ. These exact families were not present in the previously sealed1237 family packet (ignored-inclusive comparison); this comment adds scope without duplicating its common identity rule.
